listing.name: Ridge Racer — Ridge-Racer-PS1-Recomp (RobGreenUK)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Clean Mac workflow checked; Windows cross-compiled but native workflow pending; renderer improvements not physics unlock. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS-94300 CUE/BIN with all 14 tracks. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use your own disc plus local scripts; Play.command Mac, UCRT64 build-windows.sh then Play.cmd Windows; output private. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project checked a clean Mac setup. Windows was cross-compiled, but native Windows setup remains untested. Renderer improvements do not unlock physics. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
